info.name: Apifreaks Api Hub For Developers Screenshot APIs API
Build screenshots the way real users see the web — not just what fits on the screen.

params.name: format
params.description: Response format: 'json'.

params.name: output
params.description: Output format for screenshot results

params.name: file_type
params.description: File type for screenshot output

params.name: url
params.description: URLs to capture screenshots of

params.name: width
params.description: Browser viewport width in pixels

params.name: height
params.description: Browser viewport height in pixels

params.name: full_page
params.description: Capture a full-page screenshot

params.name: fresh
params.description: Bypass cache and take a fresh screenshot

params.name: no_cookie_banners
params.description: Remove cookie banners from the screenshot

params.name: enable_caching
params.description: Enable caching for repeated requests

params.name: block_ads
params.description: Block advertisements on the page

params.name: block_chat_widgets
params.description: Block chat widget scripts from loading

params.name: extract_text
params.description: Extract visible text from the page

params.name: extract_html
params.description: Extract HTML content of the page

params.name: destroy_screenshot
params.description: Auto-destroy screenshot after fetch

params.name: lazy_load
params.description: Enable lazy-loading content before screenshot

params.name: retina
params.description: Capture screenshot in high-DPI (Retina) mode

params.name: dark_mode
params.description: Render page in dark mode

params.name: block_tracking
params.description: Block common user-tracking scripts

params.name: enable_incognito
params.description: Enable private/incognito mode for browser session

params.name: omit_background
params.description: Omit background color (transparent background)

params.name: thumbnail_width
params.description: Thumbnail width in pixels

params.name: adjust_top
params.description: Adjust top in pixels

params.name: wait_for_event
params.description: Wait for a specific load event before capturing the screenshot.

params.name: grayscale
params.description: Range:0 to 100 for grayscale filter

params.name: delay
params.description: How many milliseconds to wait before taking the screenshot

params.name: timeout
params.description: Maximum timeout in milliseconds. Defalut is `10,000`

params.name: ttl
params.description: Number of seconds the screenshot should be cached

params.name: clip[x]
params.description: X position of the clipping rectangle in pixels

params.name: clip[y]
params.description: Y position of the clipping rectangle in pixels

params.name: clip[width]
params.description: Width of the clipping rectangle in pixels

params.name: clip[height]
params.description: Height of the clipping rectangle in pixels

params.name: css_url
params.description: URL to CSS file

params.name: css
params.description: Your custom CSS code

params.name: js_url
params.description: URL to JS file

params.name: js
params.description: Your JS code

params.name: block_js
params.description: Block Scripts

params.name: block_stylesheets
params.description: Block Stylesheets

params.name: block_images
params.description: Block Images

params.name: block_media
params.description: Block Media

params.name: block_font
params.description: Block Fonts

params.name: block_text_track
params.description: Block Text Tracks

params.name: block_xhr
params.description: Block XHR Requests

params.name: block_fetch
params.description: Block Fetch Requests

params.name: block_event_source
params.description: Block Event Source

params.name: block_web_socket
params.description: Block Web Sockets

params.name: block_manifest
params.description: Block Manifest

params.name: block_specific_requests
params.description: Comma- or newline-separated list of specific requests to block. Each line and comma are treated as separate requests for processing. Example: https://example.com, https://example.js

params.name: blur_selector
params.description: Comma-separated list of indexed CSS selectors to blur. Format: index:<selector>, e.g., 0:.banner,1:#ads.

params.name: remove_selector
params.description: Comma-separated list of indexed CSS selectors to remove. Format: index:<selector>, e.g., 0:.banner,1:#ads.

params.name: result_file_name
params.description: Specify a meaningful and unique file name to easily identify the screenshot result. Avoid using spaces or special characters; use hyphens or underscores to separate words.

params.name: scrolling_screenshot
params.description: **`Scrolling Screenshot`**: Capture a long scrolling screenshot. When true, disable `fullPage` and `freshScreenshot`.

params.name: scroll_speed
params.description: Speed of scrolling during the screenshot.

params.name: scroll_back
params.description: If true, the scroll will reverse back to the top after reaching the bottom.

params.name: start_immediately
params.description: If true, the scrolling capture will start immediately upon page load.

params.name: multiple_scrolling
params.description: If true, multiple scrolling screenshots will be taken at different viewport sizes.

params.name: sizes
params.description: Comma-separated list of viewport sizes in format index:XXw:YYh. Example: sizes=0:120w:300h,1:240w:500h

params.name: duration
params.description: Duration in seconds for the scrolling capture. Acceptable range is 0 to 60 seconds.

params.name: fail_on_error
params.description: If true, returns an error when the target page responds with 4xx or 5xx status.

params.name: longitude
params.description: Specify longitude for the browser Geolocation API.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Specify latitude for the browser Geolocation API.

params.name: proxy
params.description: Allows defining a proxy for the connection. Provide a JSON string with keys: server (include port number), username, and password.

params.name: headers
params.description: Custom HTTP headers to include as key=value pairs. Use a semicolon to separate multiple headers (e.g., key1=value1;key2=value2).

params.name: cookies
params.description: Cookies to include in the request before rendering. Supports single or multiple cookies. Example: cookie=value; otherCookie=otherValue;

params.name: scroll_to_element
params.description: Scrolls the page to bring the specified CSS selector into view before capture.

params.name: selector
params.description: CSS selector to capture a specific element. Only that element is rendered.

params.name: selector_to_click
params.description: CSS selector for an element to click before capturing the screenshot.

params.name: click_recursion
params.description: Number of times to click the selector (when set via selector_to_click). Default: 1.

params.name: user_agent
params.description: Custom User-Agent string sent in the request headers.

params.name: accept_languages
params.description: Sets the accepted languages for the HTTP request. Sent as the Accept-Language header.

params.name: scroll_delay
params.description: Delay in milliseconds between scroll steps when lazy_load is enabled.

params.name: custom_html
params.description: Custom HTML to render instead of loading a URL. Overrides the url option.

params.name: image_quality
params.description: Compression level for JPEG output (0–100). Lower = smaller file, higher = better quality. Only applies to JPEG.

params.name: extract_markdown
params.description: Extracts rendered page content as a structured .md (Markdown) file.

params.name: get_image_urls
params.description: Extracts all image URLs from the rendered DOM and returns them in structured format.

items.docs:
Capture full-page screenshots and videos of websites with advanced options like device simulation, custom code injection, cookie banner blocking, and scrollable content recording.
Supports multiple output formats including JSON, image, GIF, MP4, and WebM.

info.name: Capture screenshots of multiple websites in a single request.

items.docs:
Our Bulk Screenshot API allows you to capture screenshots of multiple webpages simultaneously, saving you time and effort. Instead of manually capturing each page one by one, you can batch process URLs and receive high-quality screenshots in the format you choose.
 Maximum `50 URLs` per request.
